\section{Development grid of frozen \vq{7}}\label{app:q7dev}
\textbf{Development data only.} Every set below was spent before \vq{7} was written, and \vq{7} was tuned on them. Frozen \vq{7} and frozen \vq{6} were run on every (set, extraction, mode, identity setting) of the grid, 682 pairs of runs, none missing; for the \vq{6} held-out sets the \vq{6} runs are its held-out runs. Pooled over extractions and modes, legacy scoring (the rule of the \vq{6} results). Hand-identity check: in all 190 hand runs \vq{7} returned exactly \vq{6}'s fixes (190) and tier~2 items (190). Source: \code{out/qcore7\_work/dev\_summary7.md}, \code{dev\_summary7.json}.
